newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Car sales in Philippines down in January.
newsitem.headline: Car sales in Philippines down in January.

text.p: Sales of cars in the Philippines dropped to 5,951 units in January this year compared to 7,037 units sold in January last year, an industry report said on Sunday.
Last month's sales were also down compared to December 1996 when 8,137 units were sold, statistics released by the Chamber of Automative Manufacturers of the Philippines (CAMPI) showed.
CAMPI secretary general Mario de Grano attributed the slowdown to low inventoris with car firms after brisk sales in December.

Honda Cars Philippines Inc, a unit of Honda Motor Co Ltd of Japan, remained the top car seller last month with 1,285 units sold, although this was down from the 1,616 units it sold in January last year, the statistics showed.
Mitsubishi Motor Phils Corp, a unit of Mitsubishi Motors was second with sales of 1,142 units, a rise from 1,082 units sold in the same period last year.
Nissan Motor Phils, a unit of Nissan Motor Co showed sales 919 units last month compared to 840 units in January 1996.
Toyota Motor Phils Corp, a unit of Toyota Motor Co, suffered a sharp drop in its sales last month, with 918 units sold from 1,708 sold in January last year, according to CAMPI.
